summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Portal DP - Dissídio and Validação de Folha modules. All backend API tests (11/11 passed) and frontend UI tests passed. Fixed a bug where ValidacaoFolhaResponse model required cliente_id to be non-null, causing 500 errors on /api/validacoes endpoint.

Backend: List validações endpoint works

bug_fixed.description: ValidacaoFolhaResponse model had cliente_id as required string, but some records had None value causing 500 errors
bug_fixed.fix: Changed cliente_id from 'str' to 'Optional[str] = None' in ValidacaoFolhaResponse model

seed_data_creation: Created test dissídios with TEST_ prefix for testing purposes
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Dissídio and Validação de Folha features are working. The Validação modal has two tabs - 'Análise da Folha' for simple payroll analysis and 'Comparar com Apoio' for comparing holerite with support documents. Backend endpoints /api/validacoes/analisar and /api/validacoes/comparar-apoio are functional. Test empresa 'Empresa Teste' exists. AI integration uses Gemini 2.5 Flash via Emergent LLM Key.
